notes: Standard VAT 25.5% since 1 Sep 2024 (Vero, PwC). Investment gold VAT-exempt; investment silver carries 25.5% (Tavex FAQ). Tavex, 28 Nov 2026: 100 g Valcambi bar sell 11,200.43 EUR, buyback 10,361.90 EUR = 7.5% buyback discount. Scrap: Tavex pays 56.60 EUR/g for 585 vs 102.12 EUR/g for a 999 bar = 5.3% under melt. No citable same-day spot price, so barPremiumPct left empty.

sources.name: Finnish Tax Administration (Vero) - VAT procedure for importation guidance
sources.what: Standard VAT rate increased to 25.5% effective 1 September 2024; import of investment gold is VAT-exempt (VAT Act Articles 94-96 and 72h).

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - Finland, Corporate Other taxes
sources.what: The standard VAT rate is 25.5%; customs duty rates are determined at EU level (no gold-specific rate stated).

sources.name: Tavex Oy - Sell gold or silver to Tavex (scrap buy price list)
sources.what: Dealer buy prices per gram read 28 Nov 2026: 999 bar 102.12 EUR/g, 585 (14k) 56.60 EUR/g, 750 (18k) 72.56 EUR/g; FAQ states investment gold has been VAT-free since 2000 and investment silver coins/bars carry 25.5% VAT in Finland.

sources.name: Tavex Oy - 100 g Valcambi Suisse gold bar
sources.what: Sell price 11,200.43 EUR and buyback price 10,361.90 EUR for the 100 g bar read 28 Nov 2026; the page itself states the spread as 7.49%.
